metrics.label: value-in-kind for Riot’s biggest media rights (LoL)

challenge: Esports content distribution and production is a relatively new & niche business but currently a growing trend in Vietnam market. The mission: acquire, exchange, and produce esports and sports content that best fits our OTT products’ audience, positioning, revenue-generating opportunities within the business model.
actions: I led a BD & Production team, conducted extensive market research, analyzed trends and opportunities, quantify content IPs to support decision-making on investment strategy, brand value and revenue-generating potential, established & developed strategic partnerships with publishers, organizers (Garena, Riot Games, Redbull…). optimizing budget while driving market expansion.
results: Secured full-year content licenses via a media exchange partnership with Riot Games (no cash outlay required)
Reduced content production cost >50% by improving technical solution & team workflow.
Won 2 strategic RFPs with >USD 250K in revenue
